evidence.description: CRIT-001: `grep -n "import" lending-gate.mjs` returns exactly one line (line 7, `import { isSelfFunded } from "../../../_shared/lib/is-self-funded.mjs"`); a follow-up grep for fs./fetch(/require(.http/readFileSync/Date.now() across the whole file returns zero hits. Every nowMs figure (computeRecentDefaultLossUsd, detectDefaultedLoans) is an explicit parameter, never internal Date.now().

CRIT-003: control-flow read of isBorrowerEligible confirms check order: (d) self-loan (line 102, reason:'self_loan') FIRST, then REQ-107 wallet.evm gate (line 106, reason:'not_evm'), then (a) not_self_funded (line 108), (b) not_broke_enough (line 111), (c) outstanding_loan (line 116), else 'ok' -- six reason strings, pairwise distinct by inspection.

CRIT-003 named tests re-run by adversary: 'PROP-102e: a self-loan candidate ... is rejected FIRST' PASS; 'REQ-107/PROP-107a: a Solana-only borrower ... is excluded' PASS (targeted re-run: `node --test lending-gate.test.mjs` filtered output, both lines show ✔, 56/56 pass in that file, 0 fail).

CRIT-005: verifyRepayment's alreadyCredited check (line 85) runs and returns (line 86) BEFORE the first RPC call (eth_getTransactionReceipt, line 90) -- confirmed by direct source read of statement order. matchesTransferLog (lines 33-44) compares topics[1] (from, line 41) and topics[2] (to, line 42) via strict `!==` string equality against zero-padded topics -- no .includes/.endsWith/.startsWith found anywhere in the file (grep confirms zero hits for those methods).

CRIT-005 named tests re-run by adversary, all PASS: same-loan-replay (PROP-108e), cross-loan-replay (PROP-108e), to-topic-suffix-only-rejection (PROP-108b/FIND-704), from-topic-suffix-only-rejection (PROP-108b/FIND-105), un-finalized-block-rejection (PROP-108a) -- 14/14 pass in targeted re-run of this file, 0 fail.

CRIT-007 named tests re-run by adversary, all PASS: 'PROP-106e (Tier-1 half): ... per-lender -- two different lenders never collide', 'PROP-106e/PROP-106g/PROP-106h/PROP-106k: ... unterminated' , 'PROP-106m: resolveLoanLockAcquisitionOrder ... BOTH possible orderings'.

CRIT-008: `grep -rn DEFAULT_LOW_USDC skills/economy/lending/lib/` finds only a documentary comment (line 16, no import statement); `grep -rn 'from.*decide' skills/economy/lending/lib/` finds zero hits; `grep -n 'BORROWER_LOW_USD|GOJO_SENDER_ID' skills/economy/gig/decide.mjs skills/economy/ubi/run.sh` each find zero hits. Zero-coupling holds in both directions.

CRIT-004 named tests re-run by adversary, PASS: 'PROP-114d: evaluateColdStartKillSwitch=false but evaluateOverallDefaultKillSwitch=true ... still refuses issuance' and 'PROP-114f: volume-dilution-defeat proof'. Source read of evaluateOverallDefaultKillSwitch (lending-gate.mjs:304) confirms the absolute-loss branch comparison is literally `totalRecentDefaultLossUsd >= RECENT_DEFAULT_LOSS_THRESHOLD_USD` (>=, never strict >).

CRIT-006 named tests re-run by adversary, PASS: 'reconcileProvisionalDisbursement only ever READS on-chain state -- never invokes any transfer/settle call itself' (spied eth_sendRawTransaction handler never invoked) and 'PROP-106f/PROP-106g: reconcileProvisionalDisbursement reports no match when the on-chain lookup finds nothing'. Source read confirms reconcileProvisionalDisbursement (lending-verify.mjs:124-133) calls only eth_getLogs, no write/broadcast RPC method anywhere in its body.

Adversary-written standalone adversarial script against lending-gate.mjs (10 scenarios: multi-loan debt accumulation for same defaulted borrower, negative/Infinity principal_usd flooring, NaN nowMs in detectDefaultedLoans, negative n in computeColdStartRepaymentRate, null borrowerAgent in isBorrowerEligible, corrupted duplicate loan_id across two different lender_id values, NaN totalRecentDefaultLossUsd, negative principal in computeTotalDueUsd, degenerate same-id resolveLoanLockAcquisitionOrder) -- executed, 0 failures, 0 uncaught throws. Every scenario either fails closed (never inflates surplus, never masks a default in the reachable real-caller path) or is a documented, non-reachable internal-invariant edge (e.g. NaN nowMs/negative n are never producible by the real caller, which always passes Date.now()/a fixed positive constant).

Adversary-written standalone adversarial script against lending-verify.mjs (8 scenarios: zero-value Transfer log rejection, empty '0x' data field, null receipt.logs, null receipt entirely, null finalizedBlock, RPC-level JSON error response, reconcileProvisionalDisbursement with a loanRow missing wallet fields, txHash:undefined against a ledger row lacking tx_hash) -- executed, 0 failures, 0 uncaught throws. Every malformed-RPC-shape scenario fails closed (credited:0, rejected:true) rather than throwing or crediting.

Adversary-written standalone repro, executed independently of the test suite: sumOutstandingPrincipalUsd(rows=[{principal_usd:1, repaid_usd:1.05, total_due_usd:1.10, status:'active'}], 'L1') === 0 (never -0.05); feeding that 0 into computeLenderAvailableUsd({lenderBalanceUsd:6, perCitizenReserveUsd:5, outstandingPrincipalUsd:0}) === 1 (never 1.05). FIND-902 genuinely fixed.

Adversary-written standalone repro, executed independently of the test suite: verifyRepayment against a structurally-matching Transfer log with data:'not-valid-hex-data' returns {credited:0, rejected:true} without throwing (threw=false); verifyRepayment against a receipt with blockNumber:'not-hex' likewise returns {credited:0, rejected:true} without throwing. FIND-901 genuinely fixed, both variants (log.data and receipt.blockNumber).
